changeSet.author: nexus-3wh8d.15
changeSet.comment: RDR-225 read path: the ten search families (plain_search, text_gated_search_hnsw_first, text_gated_search_by_chash, search_metadata_scoped, search_aspect_scoped, search_graph_hop, search_topic_scoped, taxonomy_ann_query, assign_from_chashes, cross_preview), each at 384, 768 and 1024, gain p_embedding_model and p_tenant and an explicit predicate on both, so a statement the engine plans with those values reaches one (model, tenant) leaf of nexus.chunks or nexus.taxonomy_centroids when it is planned. The old signatures are dropped in the same changeset (a surviving overload breaks the generated .call arity), the new ones are granted to nexus_svc explicitly, and a post-condition fails the migration unless each name has exactly one signature. assign_from_chashes and cross_preview are plpgsql and carry a function-level plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan, so their inner statements are planned with the call's own values; the inlinable SQL functions get that from the engine's session setting. No data effect: function definitions only.

changeSet.author: nexus-3wh8d.15
changeSet.comment: RDR-225 read path, the text-gate probe: text_gate_probe_384/768/1024 gain p_embedding_model and p_tenant with the same explicit predicates and keep the shape they have now. Where vectors-029 ran they are SECURITY DEFINER with a fixed search_path and the fail-closed GUC tenant predicate, and are redefined as plpgsql with a function-level plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan (a SQL definer function is never inlined and its body is planned without the call's values, so the predicates could prune only at executor start-up; plpgsql plans with the call's values), EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and granted to nexus_svc, the owner policy untouched. Where vectors-029 was skipped (nexus_svc or another RLS-subject login role has the migrating role's privileges) they are still SECURITY INVOKER and stay LANGUAGE sql, which inlines into the caller, granted to nexus_svc. One changeset that chooses by what the old probes are, and not a pair of mutually exclusive preconditioned ones, so a normal walk records no MARK_RAN row for it. No data effect.
